
RESTORE-EXAMPLE
Restore soft-deleted example by stable ID (undeletes item and clears deletedAt timestamp)

USAGE
  fspec restore-example <workUnitId> <index>

ARGUMENTS
  <workUnitId> (required)
    Work unit ID
  <index> (required)
    Example ID (stable index from show-work-unit or show-deleted)

OPTIONS
  No options available

EXAMPLES
  1. Restore deleted example with ID 2
  $ fspec restore-example AUTH-001 2
  ✓ Restored example from AUTH-001
Example reappears at index [2] in show-work-unit

RELATED COMMANDS
  fspec remove-example
  fspec show-work-unit
  fspec show-deleted
  fspec compact-work-unit

NOTES
  • Uses stable IDs that never shift when items are removed
  • Restoring an already-active item is idempotent (succeeds with message)
  • Non-existent IDs will fail with clear error message
